UNIT 01 · LESSON 02 · EXTENSION PRACTICE

Put your German
into practice.

Finished lesson 2? Check what you remember, then use it to describe your own world.

This is the extension to Lektion 2: zählen 1. Review the main lesson first if these topics are new to you.

01 Check your understanding02 Use it yourself

01 / CHECK YOUR UNDERSTANDING

Put the pieces together.

Need a reminder? Review vocabulary and numbers or articles and haben in the main lesson, then return here.

Choose one answer for each sentence, then check your work. You can change your answers and try again.

01 ___ Buch (the book)

02 ___ Tür (a door)

03 ___ Tisch (a table)

04 Ich ___ drei Bücher.

05 ___ du einen Stift?

06 Yasmin ___ einen Computer.

07 ___ Sie eine Uhr?

08 ein Stuhl → zwei ___

02 / MAKE IT YOURS

Look around. What do you have?

  1. Find objects at home and count them. Write three sentences using numbers.
  2. Look up five more objects. Record each noun, its article and its plural.
  3. Write five more sentences with these words, then say them aloud.

Ich habe zu Hause 14 Bücher.

Bring your sentences and any questions to your next live session. If you are studying independently, record yourself and listen again.

Reference material and the video are kept in the main lesson to avoid duplication. This extension has no offline-saving feature.
